subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this PR land now as the focused doctor migration field-preservation fix, accepting the upgrade-sensitive credential-store risk after owner review?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes how secret references and OAuth material are preserved during a destructive migration that removes legacy JSON files.

options.title: Land after auth-migration owner review
options.body: Accept the focused fix because the source path and before/after proof cover both lossy migration writers.

options.title: Add broader shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Ask for one more regression using an observed shipped auth-profile shape if maintainers want lower upgrade risk.

options.title: Coordinate with adjacent auth PRs
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want to batch this with the independent legacy-flat merge fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245.

recommendation.title: Land after auth-migration owner review
